manifest: data/manifest.js defines window.SATB2_DATA; manifest.json is the equivalent plain object
scope: 24 original_frozen main datasets; retained keep_for_analysis baseline only; all original cluster audit records retained, including excluded/empty groups

coordinates_payload.nuclei: Objects sorted by stable nucleus_id, zero-based array index. nucleus_id,sample,condition,cluster_id,source_cluster_id,current_cluster_id,x_harmony,y_harmony,x_unintegrated,y_unintegrated; reviewed/reference/program/uncertainty fields and qc_* fields
coordinates_payload.clusters: Native final cluster annotation rows including inclusion/exclusion flags and exact denominators
coordinates_payload.coordinate_measurement: Saved source-native embeddings; no refit after baseline mask

markers_payload.rows: Native pooled gene_cluster_summary rows for all878 stableIDs and all registered original groups
markers_payload.WT_rows: Native WT-only rows; missing means/z remain null
markers_payload.cKO_rows: Arithmetic difference of produced pooled and WT sums/denominators. Mean/fraction are null with zero denominator. scaled_expression_z and its reference are null/unavailable
markers_payload.gene_overlay: Existing cluster-mean mean_log1p_normalized, not per-nucleus expression

shards: Classic script defines window.SATB2_SHARDS[id]={encoding:'gzip-base64',data:base64_gzip_JSON}; paths relative to dashboard index. No fetch/modules/server required
coordinate_index: staging/DATASET_COORDINATE_INDEX.tsv.gz: dataset_id,tool,branch,population,nucleus_id,row_index (zero based sorted IDs). Exact TOTAL population source roster
de_owner: methods_review build_de_catalog.py; data/de_catalog.js defines SATB2_DE_CATALOG; fits__{dataset_id}; exact branch/tool/population/scope and sorted coordinate-index set must match produced fit membership
gene_id: Stable-ID sidecar; duplicate/missing display symbols retained
panel_counts: 147 review-panel rows =145 mapped rows=139 unique stableIDs, including canonical diagnostics;2 unmapped AC129186.1 rows. Workbook-only subset123 mapped rows/117 unique IDs is separately named
asset_map: data/asset_map.json: [{source_path,bundle_path,path,sha256,bytes}]; portable primary24 PDF books + completed diagnostic/program PDFs; no duplicated page PNGs
measurement_limits: No new RNA extraction/aggregation or fitting
Shared MapMyCells source is not independent truth
Offline edits cannot create new inferential results
